summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected working Greek. Neither presents a concrete fidelity defect. Both preserve continued faith without its works, the contrasting groups, the selected conjunction’s inclusion of both wavering groups, the necessity of quick repentance, and the death warning. The notes distinguish the conjunction’s restored alpha from its reported preserved letters and disclose the shorter alternative without replacing the working reading. Acceptance is limited to the supplied text and disclosures assessed against the supplied project reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a unique interpretation.
